meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查 claude-mem 保存的跨会话记忆:先搜索拿到带 ID 的索引列表,再看某条前后的时间线上下文,最后只对挑中的记录取完整详情;只有当摘要不够用时,才去取工具调用的原始输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问「这个我们是不是已经解决过了」「上次 X 是怎么做的」等涉及以往会话而非当前对话的问题时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么修认证 token 过期这个问题的?
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的搜索结果列表,再按需取详情

say.text: 帮我搜上周关于「迁移失败」的记录
say.note: 按关键词和时间范围返回索引,不直接拉全文

say.text: 把 #11131 这条观察的完整内容取出来
say.note: 用 get_observations 批量拉取完整详情

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: first search for an index of results with IDs, then view timeline context around an entry, then fetch full details only for the entries it picks. Raw tool input/output is retrieved only when the summary is not enough.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current conversation, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?".

say_en.text: How did we fix the auth token expiration last time?
say_en.note: Returns an ID list first, details on demand

say_en.text: Search last week's records about the migration failure
say_en.note: Returns an index by keyword and date range

say_en.text: Fetch the full content of observation #11131
